title: Tomato Ketchup - Heirloom
preamble:
Makes Large Quantity.
Ingredients:-
Peel
4 quarts tomatoes
2
quarts vinegar
6
chopped red peppers
4
tablespoons salt
black
pepper
2
tablespoons dry mustard
3
tablespoons allspice

Makes Large Quantity.

Peel
4 quarts tomatoes
2
quarts vinegar
6
chopped red peppers
4
tablespoons salt
black
pepper
2
tablespoons dry mustard
3
tablespoons allspice

Method:-
Place all ingredients in a kettle
Boil for 4 hours until thickened.
Bottle, seal, and serve as a condiment for meat and fish.
